prior_pending_row.question: On Retaining Divisions B and C
prior_pending_row.reason: H.R. 6938 Divisions B/C retention remains pending after complete 334350-character operative and H.Res. 977 reads; this is distinct from Division A and passage. Division B sections 307-308 import PL 117-167 section 10114 and 50 USC 2501 definitions for entity/facility restrictions. Division C permits CBP transfers for BIA roads on the 23 USC 202(b)(1) inventory; it does not guarantee a transfer, new CBP appropriation or enforcement outcome. Insular/Compact assistance imports PL 108-188 section 104(e); migrant services cannot be inferred from geography. Mining-patent section 404, Mineral Leasing Act/Mining Law, culture-grant section 128, IHS non-Indian care and its September 1987 rule funding condition, Public Lands Corps and employment/service programmes need material personal-class baselines. Final explanatory programme tables/overrides remain unfinished. Research hold only: no inclusion/exclusion, completion credit, inherited Health membership, component stance, enactment or individual legal eligibility is inferred. Further source work is executable; this is not established inaccessible evidence or a new methodology decision.
